sources.title: BertilBraun/lean4-prover-qwen3.5-4b-grpo-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LoRA adapters (rank 64) from a 3-day run of LLM-guided Lean 4 proof search on a single rented 4x RTX 3090 node, about $75 of compute. SFT. The policy learned visible-reasoning Lean data: an explanation, then tactics. The value model learned labelled search trees. Search-tree GRPO. A loop of phases ...

sources.title: BertilBraun/lean4-search-grpo-qwen3.5-4b - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Policy: a LoRA on Qwen3.5-4B that writes an explanation and a block of tactics per proof state. Value model: a Qwen3.5-2B LoRA that guides a best-first search. Training: search-tree GRPO on the search graph, then one expert-iteration round. Lean 4 checks every step.
